Avengers Endgame: Encore returns to theaters Friday 🍿🔥

🎥🎬: Avengers: Endgame

The universe has been devastated by Thanos, and the remaining Avengers are struggling to accept their defeat. Five years after the Snap, a chance to undo the damage emerges when Scott Lang escapes the Quantum Realm.

With the help of their remaining allies, the Avengers develop a plan to travel through different points in time and collect the Infinity Stones. Along the way, they encounter versions of themselves from the past and are forced to relive moments they thought were long behind them.

When Thanos discovers their plan, he launches an attack that brings nearly every hero together for one final confrontation. The battle becomes a desperate fight to restore the lives that were lost.
